observations.epoch_band_state_and_other_notes: Identity resolved to SDSS J162608.16+332827.8 / Gaia DR3 1325655193647771008; inherited 16:19:49.30 +14:53:09.96 position was an unrelated PG 1617+150 field object. Current classification is provisional: Szkody+04 proposed a polar candidate; Szkody+24 favors likely SW Sex. Periods 3.00? h and 3.17 h are retained as distinct reports. Barrett+17 reports a separate 218 +/- 22 uJy RCP-only K-band detection on 2015-05-07; latest catalog point 48 +/- 17 uJy from Barrett+20 retained, discrepancy open. Gaia EDR3 distance is Bailer-Jones geometric posterior; Barrett+20 1030 pc is preserved as a low-significance Gaia DR2-era value, not adopted.

issues.references: Barrett+17_Her1 Tables 2–3; Szkody+04_Her1 Table 1; GaiaDR3_Her1; SIMBAD_Her1; SIMBAD_Her1_oldpos
issues.why_it_matters: Wrong association would corrupt all derived physical properties.
issues.needed_action: Resolved in this audit: accept SDSS/Gaia source; retain old field object only in audit history.
issues.public_status: Resolved with evidence or reassigned outside the member sample

issues.competing_evidence: Szkody+04 calls strong-He-II target one of best polar candidates; Szkody+24 uses 3.17 h BLS/partial eclipse and favors likely high-accretion SW Sex rather than polar/IP. Neither confirms magnetic status.
issues.why_it_matters: Taxonomy affects population comparisons and whether magnetic-CV properties are assigned.
issues.needed_action: Review classification when independent polarimetry, spin modulation, or further spectroscopy is available; retain SW Sex candidate as provisional.

issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+20 Table 2 lists 3.00? h without derivation; Szkody+24 finds a 3.17 h detrended BLS period and partial eclipse, but quotes no uncertainty and says more data needed.
issues.why_it_matters: A period difference changes binary placement and any synchronization inference.
issues.needed_action: Confirm the period/alias with longer photometric and spectroscopic coverage; do not average or use as WD spin.

issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+17 Table 3 gives 218±22 microJy RCP-only in 15A-24A on 2015-05-07; Barrett+20 gives 48±17 microJy Stokes I for semester 15A with no exact block/date. Table 4 peak is a distinct map statistic. Ridder+23 excludes the later report as below 3 sigma by its criterion.
issues.references: Barrett+17_Her1 Tables 1,3,4; Barrett+20 Table 1; Ridder+23 p.6
issues.why_it_matters: Radio variability/polarization and emission comparisons depend on which flux/measurement convention applies.
issues.needed_action: Check original visibilities or observing logs and establish whether the 2017 and 2020 fluxes are separate epochs/reductions; keep both until reconciled.

issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+20 Table 2 lists 1030 pc, close to 1/parallax from Gaia DR2 0.9711±0.6630 mas (S/N≈1.46); exact transformation is not explained. Gaia EDR3 BJ geometric posterior is 2429.7 pc (1765.8–3750.3), with photogeometric median 1990.6 pc. Published radio luminosity 1241×10^21 erg/s depends on 1030 pc and assumed 256 MHz bandwidth.
issues.why_it_matters: Distance choice changes absolute magnitude and radio luminosity substantially.
issues.needed_action: Confirm intended Gaia DR2 distance transformation and rederive luminosity only after radio flux and distance convention are settled; retain both posteriors.

issues.competing_evidence: Szkody+24 reports June 2015 spectrum about five times fainter with narrow Balmer and little/no He II, citing Szkody+18; publisher and ADS PDF endpoints did not return original full text.
issues.why_it_matters: The accretion-state evidence informs SW Sex versus polar interpretation.
issues.needed_action: Obtain and inspect Szkody+18 full text and target-specific table/spectrum before treating the low-state details as primary-verified.

references.note: Present/local. Radio survey of magnetic CVs. Her 1 audit: Table lists Her 1 as AM with K-band VLA flux 48 +/-17 uJy, +100 +/-45 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.00?, distance=1030 pc, and radio-inferred B=7530 +/-365 G; no source-specific WD surface MG field, WD Teff, WD mass, or donor properties are provided. Her 1 identity remains unresolved because the source coordinate in combined_mcv_sources.csv/Barrett table (RA=244.95543, Dec=+14.88610) conflicts with a previous supplemental SDSS/Gaia association. Cas 1 audit: Table lists C-band flux 21 +/-10 uJy, -100 +/-39 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.9396 h, distance=1608 pc, and radio-inferred B=1960 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. J1503-2207 audit: Table lists X-band flux 29 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-14 percent circular polarization, Porb=2.2228 h, distance=392 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. FR Lyn correction after rendered Table 1 check: FR Lyn has only the Semester 18A X-band row, I=28 +/-4 uJy, RR=12 +/-6, LL=38 +/-6, CP=-52 +/-17%, offset=0.13 +/-0.22 arcsec, composite S/N1=43.3. The 49 +/-29 uJy K-band row with +37 +/-57% CP belongs to VV Pup Semester 13B. FR Lyn has no radio-inferred B entry in Table 2. BM CrB audit: Table lists X-band flux 43 +/-15 uJy, -100 +/-41 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.4040 h, distance=419 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. Hya 1 audit: Pelisoli+24 Appendix explicitly maps Hya 1 to RX J0859.1+0537; the prior Gaia DR3 5745881603063095680 match was a different source, MM Hya. Barrett+20 reports X-band Stokes I 6±6 μJy and custom S/N 7.3, but Ridder+23 treats the point as below 3σ. Its 2.3966 h and 441 pc values are consistent with the RX J0859 literature and Gaia DR2/EDR3 distances; the 3563±730 G inference remains conditional radio-plasma field, not WD surface field. V388 Peg audit: Table lists X-band flux 34 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-12 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.3751 h, distance=689 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. FL Cet audit: Table lists X-band flux 11 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-53 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.4523 h, distance=319 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/accretion-pole field measured from cyclotron harmonics by Schmidt+05_FLCet. LW Cam audit: Table lists X-band flux 50 +/-4 uJy, -100 +/-9 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.6211 h, distance=542 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; Section 4.2 identifies a narrow ~10.295 GHz feature and derives ~3.6 kG for the radio plasma while adopting/citing Bwd~20 MG from Ferrario+15/Tovmassian+01_LWCam. The kG value is not the WD surface field. ST LMi audit: Table lists X-band flux 153 +/-12 uJy, circular polarization entry near -100 +/-20 percent in the OCR/local text, Porb=1.8981 h, distance=113 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. V603 Aql audit: Table lists C-band 22 +/-3 uJy and X-band 32 +/-7 uJy with high circular-polarization fractions and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; Section 4.2 notes the system was included because RKcat had possible-IP context, but later work associates the photometric period with superhump/disk precession. Barrett+20 argue any WD field must be weak (<1 kG) or it would truncate the disk, so the kG radio value is not a WD surface field. MQ Dra audit: Table lists X-band flux 17 +/-4 uJy with +100 +/-34 percent circular polarization, Porb=4.3912 h, distance=186 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/accretion-region field. AP CrB audit: Table lists X-band flux 24 +/-4 uJy with weak circular polarization (-5 +/-22 percent), Porb=2.5310 h, distance=209 pc, and no radio-inferred B value in the summary table. V1007 Her audit: Table lists X-band flux 38 +/-9 uJy with +100 +/-29 percent circular polarization, Porb=1.9988 h, distance=462 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not the MG WD/cyclotron field measured by Greiner+98_V1007Her. V1323 Her audit: Table lists C-band flux 43 +/-9 uJy with +100 +/-20 percent circular polarization, Porb=4.4016 h, distance=2244 pc, and radio-inferred B=3210 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface/accretion-region MG field. AM Her audit: Table lists C-band flux 88 +/-5 uJy, plus additional X/K-band detections summarized elsewhere in the paper; Table 2 gives Porb=3.0942 h, distance=88 pc, and no radio-inferred B value for AM Her. V1432 Aql audit: Table lists X-band flux 15 +/-5 uJy, +100 +/-47 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.3656 h, distance=462 pc, and radio-inferred B=3563 +/-730 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface field. J1955+0045 audit: Table lists X-band flux 79 +/-5 uJy with circular polarization -2 +/-6 percent, Porb=1.3932 h, distance=171 pc, and no radio-inferred B value in the summary table. QQ Vul audit: Table lists K-band flux 92 +/-39 uJy with -100 +/-60 percent circular polarization, Porb=3.7084 h, distance=317 pc, and radio-inferred B=7530 +/-365 G; this is an emission-region estimate, not a WD surface/accretion-region MG field. AE Aqr audit: Table lists C-, X-, and K-band detections 5123 +/-9, 5497 +/-11, and 8031 +/-34 uJy with circular polarization 0 +/-1 percent; Table 2 lists Porb=9.8797 h, distance=91 pc, radio flux 8031 uJy, and radio luminosity 1628 (table units), with no radio-inferred B value for AE Aqr. HU Aqr audit: Table 1/2 lists X-band radio flux 44 +/-13 uJy with circular polarization -60 +/-23 percent, Porb=2.0836 h, distance about 192 pc, and no radio-inferred B value; no component masses, Teff, or WD surface field are provided. EQ Cet audit: Table 1 K-band Stokes-I flux 96 +/- 30 microJy and circular polarization +100 +/- 70%; Table 2 7530 +/- 365 G assumes fundamental ECM from donor corona; field uncertainty is based on central frequency/bandwidth, not a WD-surface field measurement. BS Tri: Table 1 gives VLA X band 7.964–10.012 GHz, Stokes I 57±9 μJy, RR 49±16 μJy, LL 0±15 μJy and circular polarization +100±45%; semester 2015A, exact date/state unstated. Table 2 field 3210±365 G is conditional on fundamental ECM and is radio-plasma/donor-coronal context, not WD field. The generic Ridder+23 exclusion of some sub-3σ Barrett detections does not apply to BS Tri (I/σ≈6.3). UZ For: Table 1 reports C-band 78±9 μJy, RR=0±25, LL=85±26 and circular polarization −100±42%; exact date/state not specified. Table 2 radio field 1960±365 G assumes fundamental electron-cyclotron maser radiation from a donor corona and is not the WD field. Tau 4: Table 1 2015A X-band Stokes I=105±32 μJy, RR=0±72, LL=150±74, CP=−100±69%; Table 2 legacy 1.50? h is superseded by K2 and 3210±365 G is conditional fundamental-ECM radio plasma, not WD field.; WX LMi audit: Table 1 reports 2015A VLA C-band Stokes I=73±12 μJy, RR=49±17, LL=26±19, CP=+31±34%; X-band I=52±14 μJy, RR=33±17, LL=48±17, CP=−19±30%. Exact observing dates and source state are not given. Table 2 does not assign WX LMi a radio-inferred magnetic field. The tabulated 17×10^21 erg s−1 radio luminosity is retained as a separate published estimate, based on 99 pc and 73 μJy; the convention/input distance differs from Gaia-based values.; ST LMi audit: Table 1 2015A X-band 7.964–10.012 GHz Stokes I=153±12 μJy, RR=0±30, LL=221±31 μJy, CP=−100±20%; phase/state/date are not specified beyond semester. Table 2 B=3210±365 G is a conditional radio-emission/plasma-region estimate, not WD surface MG field.; AR UMa Table 1: three Semester 13B detections at C/X/K with the tabulated Stokes I, RR, LL, circular polarization, and radio-to-optical positional offsets transcribed separately. The semester is the only table epoch; source accretion state and exact observing dates are not given. Do not conflate these data with the five later 16B measurements summarized by Mason+24. EU UMa: Table 1 reports one 2018A X-band detection (Stokes I, RR/LL and CP); earlier 2013 VLA nondetections and exact limits in Barrett+17 Table 4 are retained separately. V1043 Cen Table 1: semester 18A X-band Stokes I=20±5, RR=0±7, LL=20±8 microJy, CP=−100±53%, centroid offset=0.16±0.60 arcsec, custom total S/N=11.2. The paper says the first detection was highly polarized and a second was not; exact date/state mapping is not tabulated. Table 2 B=3563±730 G assumes donor-coronal fundamental ECM and is not a WD surface field.; AM Her Table 1 C/X/K band Stokes I, RR, LL and CP values and Table 2 Porb=3.0942 h checked. No radio-inferred B is assigned to AM Her in Table 2.; FR Lyn correction: rendered Table 1 p. 1228 lists only Semester 18A X band for FR Lyn: offset 0.13±0.22 arcsec; I 28±4 uJy; RR 12±6; LL 38±6; CP -52±17%; composite S/N1=43.3. The apparent FR Lyn K row 49±29 uJy, CP +37±57% is actually the adjacent VV Pup 13B K row and catalog row 11 was corrected. Table 2 gives older Gaia DR2 distance 550 pc and compiled 1.8876 h; no radio-inferred field for FR Lyn.

cmd.distance_method: Bailer-Jones Gaia EDR3 geometric distance posterior
cmd.adoption_reason: Release-selected distance used; no compatibility absolute magnitude consumed.
cmd.uncertainty_method: Recorded distance endpoints transformed nonlinearly at fixed G; retain the recorded interval convention, including unspecified conventions. Posterior quantiles are not Gaussian errors. Photometric error separate. Color error, where both available, approximates independent BP/RP errors in quadrature; covariance and variability ignored.
cmd.photometry_status: Observed Gaia DR3 mean system photometry; unresolved light, not extinction-corrected
cmd.qualifications: Host/subclass candidate or disputed; inspect source evidence; Bayesian geometric prior; unresolved system photometry and variability; Broad distance posterior; prior sensitivity matters
